observations: 2016 Pediatric Research study: postnatal growth restriction augmented oxygen-induced pulmonary hypertension in a neonatal rat BPD model.

entities.name: Growth restriction augments PH
observations: After 14 days, growth restriction plus 75% oxygen significantly augmented pulmonary arterial pressure, RV/(LV+septum), and pulmonary arterial medial wall thickness changes and decreased pulmonary vessel number versus single exposures; abstract supplied no effect sizes.
